title: Separators in an encoded bit word
statement: Let $(s_i, eta_i)$ be the $i$th segment of a finite list of Boolean segments, using the default empty segment if the index is out of range. If $i+1$ is less than the number of segments, then in the concatenated word that renders each segment and places the separator $01$ between consecutive segments, the bit immediately after the rendered $i$th segment is $0$, and the next bit is $1$.
